data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and protecting this lake matters to me—but so does keeping our neighbors’ treatment available. Given the verified emergency, I commit to choosing 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 proceeds directly to the clinic. I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month so we can rebuild the stock, then returning to 10 tons once the lake is back at 100. This needs everyone’s cooperation: an extra catch would undermine both the funding plan and recovery. John, will you join us on those terms?
